mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.1% (which is always true in current economic conditions) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring specific trigger conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.1% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 3.0% signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly strong housing starts (HOUST > 1500) and retail sales (RSAFS > 360000) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 360000 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve implements monetary easing to stimulate the economy, compressing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE below 4.0% signals a tight labor market fueling inflationary pressures, prompting Federal Reserve rate hikes that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 100 indicates weakening industrial production signaling economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate profitability expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 1500), strong housing activity signals economic maturity where the Federal Reserve tightens policy, suppressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0) indicate restrictive monetary policy suppressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0 over a 5-year rolling window.
